reviewedPaths: Fifteen collector stubs remain inactive and contain no collection, HTTP, database write, schedule or provider operation.
All database nodes bind only the restricted dev writer credential and parameterized ops RPCs, with no service/admin substitution or direct project-table DML.
Start has no automatic retry; ambiguous native starts require history reconciliation. Idempotent cost/atomic callback paths use bounded existing RPC contracts.

Finish with an atomic completion reads the saved registry receipt, verifies durable identity/counts/summary and does not finish the run again. False replay flags do not dispatch; first-receipt resubmission remains explicitly at-least-once for harmless M03 stubs.
Notifications are log-only and use fixed summaries; arbitrary subject/HTML/provider messages and raw stacks are not persisted or sent.

WF91 binds Cairo yesterday explicitly for accrual, uses idempotent fixed-fee RPCs, rejects a changed day before notification dispatch, and fails before writes if the unsupported stats-refresh setting is enabled.
WF91 preserves budget/failing-source branch routing, distinct safe notification IDs and the stats publish stub; unknown fixed fees remain unpriced rather than fabricated.
